title: Authority Before Utility: Non-Compensatory Control for Persistent LLM Memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.37474v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent memory creates a control problem that retrieval relevance alone does not solve: a memory can remain highly useful after an update, deletion, or revocation makes it inadmissible for the current answer. We formalize this as a separation between utility and authority. A fixed finite penalty applied to an unnormalized utility score cannot guarantee exclusion under arbitrary positive-affine reparameterization of that score; by contrast, rank-normalized compensation is scale-invariant and therefore forms a stronger empirical comparator.   Our prospectively frozen TIDE/LongMemEval primary was quarantined before a valid HELDOUT comparison because the materialized TIDE adapter conflated historical age with query-relative inadmissibility and the aligned LongMemEval split left no DEV set for the predeclared penalty selection. translated_title: 权威先于效用：面向持久化LLM记忆的非补偿性控制
translated_abstract: 持久化记忆带来了一个仅靠检索相关性无法解决的控制问题：当更新、删除或撤销操作使某条记忆不再适用于当前答案时，该记忆可能仍然高度“有用”。我们将这一问题形式化为“效用”与“权威”之间的分离。对未归一化的效用分数施加固定的有限惩罚，无法在该分数的任意正仿射重参数化下保证排除失效记忆；相比之下，秩归一化补偿具有尺度不变性，因此构成更强的实证比较基准。我们前瞻性冻结的 TIDE/LongMemEval 主实验在有效的 HELDOUT 对比之前被隔离，原因在于具体实现的 TIDE 适配器将记忆的历史年龄与相对于查询的不适用性混为一谈，且对齐的 LongMemEval 数据划分没有为预先声明的惩罚选择保留 DEV 集合。因此，我们在 Memora Remembering 上报告一项主实验之后的替代性诊断，其中更新/删除操作……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将持久化LLM记忆中的“权威”（是否允许使用）与“效用”（是否有用）正式分离，证明对效用分数施加固定惩罚无法在任意尺度变换下保证排除已被撤销的记忆，必须采用尺度不变的非补偿性控制（如秩归一化补偿）才能可靠地阻止失效记忆进入答案。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the separation between utility and authority in persistent LLM memory, proving that fixed finite penalties cannot guarantee exclusion of inadmissible memories under arbitrary positive-affine rescaling, and that scale-invariant non-compensatory control (e.g., rank-normalized compensation) is required to reliably block revoked memories.
